description: This PHP class defines a framework component for handling CSS properties that accept multiple values, such as 'border-width' or 'margin'. It provides validation logic for parsing and validating such multi-value CSS attribute definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Multiple
classes.description: A class for handling CSS attribute definitions that accept multiple values, enforcing a maximum number of values, and delegating validation of individual values to another attribute definition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the single value handler and maximum allowed values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS property value string, splitting input into parts, validating each part with the delegated single value validator, and ensuring the total number of values does not exceed the maximum.
